risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- The Wind Energy Business has recently been operating at lower utilisation levels due to theft incidents at the project site, impacting generation.
- Competitive tariffs, project costs, grid connectivity constraints, power offtake, financing requirements and generation performance risk affect the commercial viability of wind projects.
- Government policy amendments to import/export policies or development of new port infrastructure near existing ports, plus operational hazards, natural disasters and pandemic situations, may impact business dynamics.
- Major Port Trust Authorities keep floating new tenders for interested investors to create additional liquid storage capacity, which may impact the efficiency of occupation of the Company's storage tanks.
- Given the relatively smaller market size and limited depth of customer base in certain Tier-III locations, there is a possibility of temporary vacancy or slower re-leasing on customer exits, which could lower utilisation and moderately impact revenue.
- Costs of cement, steel, aluminum, labour, diesel, equipment rentals, plumbing and electrical fixtures have increased, while rental rates in Tier-III warehousing markets may not rise proportionately due to competitive dynamics.
- The Company remains cognizant of increasing competitive intensity, seasonal demand and location-specific demand fluctuations affecting the warehousing business.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Liquid Storage: leverage existing storage infrastructure at strategic locations, experienced manpower, security and strategic third-party alliances.
- Warehousing: optimise utilisation of existing assets, diversify customer portfolio toward stable non-agricultural customers, and selectively pursue capacity expansion and customised warehousing opportunities.
